Name: AureliusJobBars
Description:
Additional job gauges, party buff timers, mitigation trackers, and more. Icon by PAPACHIN

Fork of 0ceal0t/JobBars: the game's own action tooltip when hovering Buffs/Cooldowns icons, and cooldowns hidden until the party member's level unlocks them.
Punchline: Extra job gauges, with native action tooltips on hover
Changelog: Shows the real in-game action tooltip (triggered directly via NodeBase.ShowTooltip from our own hit-test), and fixes the hover rect to include the host addon's scale. Bars stay click-through.
